# Vervant PDF API

> Developer-first HTML-to-PDF API for SaaS backends; hosted service is currently in private-beta preparation and not publicly available.

## Product

Vervant is building an HTTP API that converts caller-supplied HTML or reusable templates into PDF documents for invoices, receipts, statements and reports.

Verified prototype functionality includes:
- HTML-to-PDF generation.
- Reusable Handlebars templates.
- API-key creation and revocation.
- Monthly usage limits and generation history.
- Page JavaScript disabled while rendering.
- Outbound and local network requests blocked during rendering.
- A4, Letter, Legal and Tabloid output, margins, background printing and landscape output.
- HTML limited to 1 MB, CSS limited to 256 KB, request body limited to 2 MB, and bounded rendering concurrency.

## Interactive local demo

- Invoice preview builder: https://vervant-pdf-api.deed.page/tools/invoice-preview/
- Runs in the visitor's browser. It does not upload, store or transmit invoice information.
- It uses browser print-to-PDF and is a layout demonstration, not the hosted Vervant API or tax/accounting software.

## Important security limitation

The current runtime launches Chromium with --no-sandbox because its constrained Linux environment cannot start the built-in sandbox. Disabling page JavaScript and blocking page network requests reduce attack surface but do not provide process isolation. The hosted API is not publicly available. Do not send production, personal, confidential or sensitive customer documents. The prototype has not received an independent security audit or certification.

## Availability

The static product website, guides and local invoice-preview demo are public. The hosted API, public registration and live payments are not open.
